lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four horizontal rows. The most prominent blobs form a recurring rectangular pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes where the largest high-intensity clusters are positioned.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical transition from high-luminance upper edges to shaded lower edges, extending from the gills toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin, partially visible in the upper right quadrant, contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance spots distributed across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller, more concentrated white spots compared to the larger, sparser blobs found on the lateral flank.
